intersections.note: inset panel (top left, inside the heavy line). Only Spring Grove's north face is drawn (lot 200 corner at x 220, y 1855); the centre, 50 ft south of that face on Platt's centreline, falls on the heavy panel border itself, so this point is extrapolated (use with care)

north leg of Mitchell (50 ft, running nearly north-south along the east side of Chester Park) meets the Spring Grove centreline here. Mitchell does not continue straight: its south leg leaves Spring Grove about 265 px (43 ft) further SW (next pick)
south leg of Mitchell (printed MITCHELL AV., no width printed, drawn about 60 ft) leaves Spring Grove to the SE toward 656; its centreline is projected back to the Spring Grove centreline

Donnell St. (drawn 50 ft, no width printed here) leaves Spring Grove to the SSW; its east face and Mitchell's west face meet in a sharp point on the Spring Grove south face (x 5626, y 5959), so Donnell and the south leg of Mitchell branch from almost the same spot (about 48 px apart)

bends.note: both water pipes and the lot line kink here: west of it Spring Grove rises at about 17 deg on the page, east of it at about 26 deg

notes: Two panels. MAIN: Chester Park (Chester Park Athletic Club amusement resort, lake) with Spring Grove Av (100 ft) along the bottom from the lower left (north face at lot 202, x 370, y 7570) NE to Mitchell, and Mitchell Av (50 ft) up the right edge with the Cincinnati Car Co. works; no streets cross Mitchell on this sheet. At the lower right the north leg of Mitchell, the south leg of Mitchell (to 656) and Donnell St. all meet Spring Grove, with a jog of about 43 ft between the north and south legs of Mitchell. Platt Av. is only labelled in a small box at the left edge of the main panel (x about 80-310, y 4650-5280); its street lies west of the park fence and is not drawn, and the Platt / Spring Grove crossing of the main panel would fall off the bottom of the sheet. INSET (top left, bounded by the heavy line from x 1900 at the top to x 1350, y 2000 and west to the left edge): Platt Av. (25 ft) and Spring Grove Av. (north face only, lots 200-201), drawn rotated about 22 deg relative to the main panel; the lines marked A and B in the inset and at the lower left of the main panel are the match line between the two panels (the car shed and the spiral tower appear in both). Spring Grove's south face is drawn only from about x 2700 east in the main panel (faces about 620 px apart). Railroads, scenic railway and park paths ignored.
